ignoreValues.reason: Verified false positive: body has overflow-x:hidden while html is overflow:visible, so per CSS overflow propagation the value is applied to the viewport and body itself computes to overflow:visible, establishing no clipping context. Sticky nav and skip link both unaffected. Confirmed in /impeccable audit.

Verified false positive in /impeccable audit: .sec sets padding-block only but every section's children are wrapped in .shell, which supplies the 24px inline gutter; .modal is padding:0 by design with text in .modal__body at 34px/32px. No text meets a boundary.
Intentional and documented in DESIGN.md Shapes: the primary CTA's 1px pure-black hairline is the signature CTA anatomy inherited from reference/brand-guide.md, and is the only true black on the page.
Same CTA hairline as #000, reported in computed form. Documented in DESIGN.md Shapes.

Detector concatenation of 'border-radius: var(--r-card) var(--r-card) 0 0' on .frame--card. Documented in DESIGN.md Shapes: the project card frame carries the radius on its top two corners only so the image meets the body flush.

Sanctioned exception documented in DESIGN.md: reference/brand-guide.md specifies ABC Social / Roc Grotesk / SocialMono, which are licensed and unavailable to this project, and names 'ABC Social', 'Inter', sans-serif as its own fallback stack. Exit condition recorded in DESIGN.md: swap to the licensed faces if they are ever obtained.
